Ace 1.44.0
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ace-builds
License: BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE.txt)

Bundled files:
- ace.js
- Official theme modules
- Syntax mode modules used by the HUSTOJ language catalog

Local packaging note:
- mode-python.js keeps the original identifier range while spelling its four
  Unicode range endpoints as UTF-8 characters to satisfy the project-wide
  no-backslash-u source policy.

Workers are not used by OJ Platform. Syntax checking and judging remain on
the configured judge server.
